question: Does the recorded 0.0-2.7% cap-20 asserted-coverage range reproduce on the amended engine?
instrument: benchmarks/run_paired_capacity_test.py :: run_paired_condition, control arm, max_predictions=20, cycles 0-109
reproducibility: Deterministic within a build: seed 20261101 run twice on e6d1bcc returned 81 both times, and PYTHONHASHSEED=0 returned 81. The amended build returns 59 for the same seed in separate processes.
finding: The 0.0-2.7% range reproduces on the build that recorded it (89b0744, seed 20261101: 1 of 112 against a recorded 0 of 112) and does not reproduce on any build from 9f2c8e1 (2026-11-04) onward. e6d1bcc, the commit the freeze was taken against, reads 0.6607-0.8125; the amended engine reads 0.4821-0.75. The amendment therefore lowers this basis by 0.06-0.18 but does not return it to the recorded band; the move that matters happened on 2026-11-04, before the amendment.
not_measured: The cap-1000 treatment arm has since been re-run on 2026-11-06 and still clears the gate: 112 of 112 world edges on all five seeds, on both later builds — see docs/gate13_cap1000_build_comparison.json. What remains uncovered here is one seed only: the re-check of 89b0744 measures 20261101, not all five.
